Claire is an AI clinical partner — an AI senior resident that works alongside physicians. Before the visit, Claire interviews the patient and gathers a complete history. During and after the visit, it organizes that information into a structured clinical record and drafts the note for your review. You stay in control of every clinical decision; Claire handles the intake, history-taking, and documentation that otherwise eat into your day.

## The last patient leaves at 5. The notes aren't done until 9.

After-hours charting isn't a willpower problem — it's a workflow problem. Every visit leaves behind intake, history, and documentation that pile up until they follow you home. That lost time is capacity you never get back: fewer patients seen, less presence in the room, and the slow burn of administrative work.

## Not another scribe. A clinical partner for the whole encounter.

Scribes start recording when the visit starts. Claire starts before it — interviewing the patient, building a structured history, and organizing the data so you walk in already prepped. Then it drafts the note. Purpose-built for the clinical workflow, not a general tool pointed at medicine.

## Claire drafts. You stay the attending.

Delegating documentation should never mean delegating judgment. Claire works like a senior resident who has already seen the patient and handed you a clean write-up — but the encounter, the decisions, and the signed note are always yours. You review, you edit, you own every word.

Clinical AI Agent for Pre-Visit Intelligence & Documentation

# A Clinical AI Agent for Notes

###### Automate your patient intake notes with our AI agent, get all PHI pre-visit and reduce your documentation time by up to 40%. 

## Challenges in Chronic Care

Documentation takes too much time for physicians and patient health information comes in pieces.

The reality of documentation today:

Physicians spend excessive time on documentation instead of care

Incomplete pre-visit history leads to rushed consults and missed context

Providers reported that incomplete data at in-take results in up to 70% of denials (Experian 2025)

The Result: delayed care, insurance denials, and revenue loss.

## Clinical Intelligence Built for Clinics

MayaMD adds a layer of clinical intelligence to your workflows - before, during, and between visits - without adding operational burden.

Pre-Visit Consult Intelligence

Before a patient even steps into the clinic, MayaMD engages them through natural language conversations to capture everything clinicians need to know in a structured way

- Collects symptoms, medical history, ROS, medications, labs, and screenings
- Captures new 2026 MIPS oral-health screening requirements automatically
- Generates a complete, structured consult note in your EMR before the appointment

During the Visit

Clinicians start the visit informed, prepared, and compliant.

- Ready-to-use consult notes available at the start of the visit
- Less charting, more clinical judg
